scope: Powerhouse Portal V2 contextual intelligence visualization
problem: Company Intelligence OS runtime existed, but its Company Graph, context, action, outcome and learning semantics were not consistently visible where users make decisions in Portal V2.
root_cause: The runtime architecture and portal UI evolved separately; existing cockpit, roadmap, evidence and decision surfaces had no shared Company Intelligence visual contract.
proven_fix: Add one reusable tenant-scoped Company Intelligence context renderer and project it into executive cockpit, company cockpit, impact, next-best-actions, monitoring/learning, evidence health and roadmap.
prevention: Never create a separate Company Intelligence dashboard when context can be embedded in an existing decision surface.
Never read global Company Intelligence runtime views directly into customer UI unless tenant isolation is explicit and proven.
Portal visualizations must fail closed when tenant evidence is missing.
Expected value remains distinct from realized value.
Outcome Memory and learning are shown only when evidence exists.
All material contextual projection changes update the canonical System Map, skill, tests, docs and ledger in the same lineage.
Roadmap and capability graph surfaces must show contextual intelligence when tenant-scoped evidence exists; do not strand intelligence in the cockpit.
Every material Company Intelligence capability must define a decision-useful Portal V2 projection or explicitly document why no customer projection is appropriate.
Contextual portal projection uses authenticated tenant runtime only; demo, global aggregate or synthesized data may never fill a missing tenant context.
Forecast/expected values and observed/realized outcomes must remain visually and semantically distinct.
Contextual portal projection changes must update skill, learning, System Map, tests, change documentation and development ledger in the same lineage.

invariants: no global unscoped graph read into customer portal

governance.customer_language: Wat zien we? → Waarom telt dit? → Wat verwachten we? → Wat doen we? → Wat kwam eruit? → Wat leren we?
